Before you choose

Find the right level,
then the right time.

Some subjects have more than one class. The timetable distinguishes Higher, Ordinary and year-specific sessions where the business lists them.

Hybrid learning is advertised for students who cannot attend in person. Ask Caitriona whether your selected class is available online.

What happens next?

  1. 01
    Choose your subject and levelUse the published timetable to identify a class.
  2. 02
    Talk to CaitrionaConfirm that the class suits your student and that a place is available.
  3. 03
